rationale: C12 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template: it performs the same specific act of redefining exterior national-forest boundaries, identifies the forests through their prior establishing directives, inserts a detailed boundary description, and then reserves federally owned lands within the newly defined boundaries as parts of the forests. C03 and C05 use closely related national-forest boundary and reservation machinery, but C12 most directly matches the child's purpose, sequence, and operative wording.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The exterior boundaries of the Caribbean National Forest in Puerto Rico, established as the Luquillo Forest Reserve by Proclamation Number 41 ... and renamed ... are hereby relocated and redefined as follows
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the exterior boundaries of the Allegheny National Forest ... established by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] ... [and other forests] ... shall be located and defined as set forth in the descriptions
shared_material.explanation: Both identify previously established national forests and formally replace or redefine their exterior boundaries through an ensuing legal description.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Beginning at the point where ...; thence ...; ... the point of beginning.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Beginning at the intersection ...; thence ...; ... to the point of beginning.
shared_material.explanation: Both implement the boundary change through an extended metes-and-bounds description organized as a beginning point followed by successive courses returning to that point.

shared_material.child_excerpt: All lands of the United States within those exterior boundaries are hereby reserved as parts of the Caribbean National Forest.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: all national-forest lands within those boundaries are hereby reserved as parts of the respective national forests within which they are located
shared_material.explanation: This is a close and material match in the operative reservation clause following the boundary redefinition.
